feeds.title: Chica Beauty Blog
feeds.description: Since founding Chica Girl Magazine in 2009, we have been on a mission to empower girls to be their authentic selves. We believe that makeup should accentuate each person's natural features, not cover them. So, when we created Chica Beauty, we envisioned something more than just makeup; we wanted to provide simple beauty solutions and build a community that supports each other and celebrates true beauty.

feeds.title: Sincerely Jules
feeds.description: I'm Julie (a.k.a Jules), welcome to my little world, Sincerely Jules, where you'll see bits and pieces of my outfits, my fun travels, my favorite products, my beauty tips & tricks, parts of my home, sneak peeks of cool collabs, launches + more! Sincerely Jules is my happy place where I love to share parts of my life with you and bring you along for the ride!

feeds.title: BELatina » Beauty
feeds.description: BELatina is an online source of healthy beauty tips and news. We write stories in a way that's smart, informative, fun, and supportive - of your relationships, your choices, your goals, and you. Our mission is to inspire readers to be the best versions of themselves.

feeds.title: Camila Coelho » Beauty
feeds.description: Latina beauty and fashion guru Camila Coelho and her website is a one-stop shop for beauty hacks and tips. Camila also shares articles on fashion, travel, accessories, hair, and more.

feeds.title: HipLatina » Beauty
feeds.description: HipLatina is a Latina-owned beauty brand sharing makeup & skincare product guides here! Dedicated to highlighting the diversity of the U.S. Latina experience, HipLatina empowers and entertains by providing thoughtful, engaging content on the topics Latinas care about most. From politics to beauty to culture, we give a voice to our strong, forward-thinking readers.

feeds.title: The Kisha Project
feeds.description: The author Kisha is an Afro-Latina wife, mom, and former flight attendant. Born in Panama, raised in Little Rock currently residing in Phoenix. She shares insights about motherhood, parenting, lifestyle, and much more on her blog.

feeds.title: By Lynny
feeds.description: By Lynny is a beauty-focused lifestyle blog by Lynnette Hernandez. At bylynny.com you can find makeup tutorials, home decor, food and drink recipes, and more.

feeds.title: Beauty Logic Blog
feeds.description: Beauty Logic blog is a team of writers that examines the latest beauty trends. We cover makeup, hair products, fashion & more.

feeds.title: Latinista » Beauty
feeds.description: A Lifestyle magazine dedicated the following segment to, beauty news from Hispanic and Latina lifestyle contributors from around the world. Latinista Magazine is the destination for the Latina woman who sets the direction of her own life and lives it to its fullest and her own terms. Her point-of-view is unmistakably American, her culture is full of color, food, music, unwavering in its optimism and wide open to great things ahead.

feeds.title: Stylescrapbook » Beauty
feeds.description: The following section of Stylescrapbook is dedicated to beauty. Andy Torres is Mexican born and raised but established herself in Europe where she founded StyleScrapbook in November 2007. The blog quickly became one of the leading fashion blogs in the world and catapulted Andy into a career of her own as an entrepreneur and pioneer within the blogging industry.

feeds.title: Spoiled Latina
feeds.description: As a leading lifestyle, fashion and beauty expert in my community, I work with a variety of local and national brands to amplify their social media and advertising needs. I love to work with all businesses that fit the brand. SpoiledLatina.com focuses on fashion, beauty, music, entertainment, parenting and travel making it a leading Latina Lifestyle blog.

feeds.title: Sweet Soul Blog
feeds.description: Hola, I'm Dulce Candy; a mom, wife, entrepreneur, published author, immigrant, Iraq War Veteran, meditation teacher, and so much more. This is where I am delivering online resources with tangible steps for ladies who desire spiritual, emotional and physical healing.

feeds.title: La Galarza Blog
feeds.description: La Galarza Blog is a space for fashion lovers, I have a leather goods heart, I am crazy about shoes and I enjoy sharing with you tips that will make your life easier along with fashion, beauty, and lifestyle tips.

feeds.title: Classy Latina » Beauty
feeds.description: Get the latest trends in beauty and style on Classy Latina. Classy Latina is the premier online magazine empowering Latinas to continue being stylish and Caliente!

feeds.title: Queen Bee Latina » Fashion & Beauty
feeds.description: I am Angela Saldaña Camacho aka 'Queen Bee Latina'. Find the latest articles on fashion & beauty by the Queen Bee Latina Blog. Queen Bee Latina is a Latina lifestyle blogger with a passion for adventure, travel, culture, food, and entertainment.

feeds.title: Sisterly Style
feeds.description: We are Amelia and Elisa. SISTERLY STYLE is our portfolio to the world about our style. It is our voice and the way in which we make everything that surrounds us unique and different and inspires us while we share with our community a congruent, healthy and happy lifestyle through experiences, trips, adventures and day-to-day trends.

feeds.title: Priscilla Eslo
feeds.description: Priscilla Eslo was born in 2014 as a source of inspiration for women, men, and moms who are interested in budget-friendly fashion, trends, beauty tips, and lifestyle. Priscilla was born and raised in Nicaragua, but she is currently living in the USA.

feeds.title: Latina Style
feeds.description: Corporate America´s initiatives for careers of professional Hispanic women. LATINA Style Magazine is the most influential publication reaching the contemporary Hispanic professional working woman. The culturally sensitive editorial environment we provide showcases Latina achievements in all areas, including business, science, civic affairs, education, entertainment, sports, and the arts.

feeds.title: Rocio Isabel
feeds.description: Hey, Y'all! I'm Rocío! I am of strong Mexican and Honduran roots and will never turn away an opportunity to share what I love about being Latina. So in this blog, you'll get a little of everything. All of the things that make me ME! From this new journey into motherhood and married life to faith, travel, fashion, and food! Of course, I'll continue to share my favorite beauty finds.
